elevation.note: ambientColor / keyColor are theme alphas; a "Brand" suffixed set also exists.

structure.note: A 16-step brand ramp (10–160) is the only theme input; createLightTheme/createDarkTheme map it and the fixed grey ramp (lightness 2–98) onto alias colour tokens.

algorithm.name: createLightTheme(brand) / createDarkTheme(brand)
algorithm.description: No colour is computed: each alias token indexes the brand ramp or the grey ramp (e.g. colorBrandBackground = brand[80] in light, brand[70] in dark).

tokens.name: lang ja
tokens.value: 'Yu Gothic UI', 'Meiryo UI', Meiryo, 'MS Pgothic', Osaka

findings: @fluentui/tokens (Fluent 2 / v9) has three font stacks (base, monospace, numeric), all Latin Segoe UI; no token varies by language, script or direction, and line heights are fixed px pairs with the font sizes (14/20, 12/16, 16/22).

Per-language stacks exist only in the older @fluentui/theme (v8): LanguageToFontMap covers 26 language prefixes; "ar" maps to 'Segoe UI Web (Arabic)' followed by the fallbacks ('Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Roboto', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif). It swaps the family only — sizes and line heights are unchanged.

RTL in v9 is done by the Griffel compiler, which emits a flipped rule for every physical declaration (the compiled styles contain both .f… {padding-left} and its right twin); raw sources are written with physical properties.
No density token or mode: controls have size small/medium/large (24/32/40px).
